categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production, and sales of functional sun-shading materials. The main products include three major categories: blackout fabrics, adjustable light fabrics, and outdoor sun-shading fabrics, with over a thousand product varieties. These materials combine multiple functions including sun-shading, light adjustment, energy efficiency, and environmental protection, with additional features such as antibacterial, anti-pollution, and formaldehyde removal capabilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies including multi-layer adjustable light fabric one-time weaving technology, batch embroidery rolling technology, high-polymer material pelletizing technology with high flame retardancy and UV resistance, environmentally-friendly water-based acrylic foam coating technology, and roll curtain cup weight control technology. The company uses advanced imported equipment including Italian Smit looms, German Dornier looms, and Korean setting and coating equipment. Production follows ISO9001, ISO14001, and OHSAS18001 certified processes with strict quality control throughout the entire production chain.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's customers are primarily sun-shading product manufacturers. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with approximately 70% of sales from overseas markets across more than 70 countries and regions on six continents. Key markets include Europe, Asia, and the Americas. Domestically, products are distributed across all provinces with concentration in East China and South China regions. Products are applied in commercial buildings (offices, hotels, shopping malls), residential real estate, sports venues, and other large public buildings.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Shandong Province, China, with headquarters in Shouguang City. It has established a subsidiary in the United States (YUMA USA INC) in Ontario, California. The company exports to over 70 countries and regions across six continents, with major markets in Europe, Asia, and the Americas. Approximately 67% of revenue comes from overseas markets, while 33% comes from domestic Chinese markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the supply chain as a functional sun-shading material manufacturer. It sources raw materials (polyester fiber, water-based acrylic latex, PVC) from upstream suppliers and sells finished materials to downstream sun-shading product manufacturers who produce finished products for end consumers in the construction and home decoration industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous innovation in functional sun-shading materials with emphasis on energy efficiency, environmental protection, and multi-functional properties. Current R&D initiatives include high-polymer composite fabrics, high-reflective sun-shading materials, ultra-fine high-polymer composite fabrics, high-polymer coating sun-shading materials, outdoor sun-shading awnings, recycled material sun-shading fabrics, high-performance sound-absorbing sun-shading fabrics, and five-function zebra blinds. The company collaborates with universities and research institutions for technology development and participates in national standard formulation.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of functional sun-shading materials to sun-shading product manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also generates minor revenue from other business activities. The revenue model is based on buy-out sales with customers, with approximately 70% from overseas markets and 30% from domestic markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the leading enterprise in China's functional sun-shading materials industry and a national standard-setting unit. It is the only company in the industry to hold the 'China Famous Trademark' designation and the 'China Sun-shading Window Decoration New Material Innovation Demonstration Base' title. The company competes in the first tier of the industry alongside other large-scale manufacturers with advanced technology and high-quality products. International competitors include Hunter Douglas, Phifer, Mermet, Gale Pacific, Junkers & Müllers, and Serge Ferrari, which dominate developed markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2023 revenue of 663.02 million yuan, representing 21.30% growth from 546.62 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 165.04 million yuan in 2023, up 5.36% from 156.65 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 1.48 billion yuan at year-end 2023, up 9.23% from 1.36 billion yuan at year-end 2022. The company demonstrates steady growth with strong profitability and cash generation, with operating cash flow of 210.16 million yuan in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through superior product quality, advanced technology, and comprehensive functionality. Key differentiators include: industry-leading blackout rates (100% for full blackout products), exceptional flatness control, superior color fastness (8-level standard), high flame retardancy (NF P 92-507 M1 level), and multi-functional capabilities (antibacterial, anti-pollution, formaldehyde removal, UV protection). The company offers customized solutions with rapid response to customer needs, extensive product variety (over 1,000 SKUs), and strong technical support. The company emphasizes environmental sustainability and energy efficiency, positioning products as green building materials aligned with national carbon reduction goals.
